name: newsletter
description: Let your agent save the newsletter issues you choose as unsent drafts in your beehiiv, Kit, Buttondown or Ghost account, and read how each issue did. You always press Send yourself.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Newsletter
examples: Save this week's issue as a draft in my newsletter tool so I can send it
How did my last newsletter do? Clicks, unsubscribes and replies, not opens
How many subscribers do I have, and how many joined in the last 90 days?

methods.label: beehiiv
methods.detail: An API key from your beehiiv workspace. Saving drafts needs a plan with the create-post API (Pro or Enterprise); reading stats works on every plan.

setup.title: Create an API key in beehiiv
setup.detail: In beehiiv open Settings, then Workspace Settings, then API, and click Create New API Key. Name it Dimension and copy the key: beehiiv shows it once.

setup.title: Copy your publication id (only if you have several)
setup.detail: The same API page lists each publication's id, starting with pub_. With one publication you can leave it blank; Dimension finds it.

form.label: beehiiv API key
form.help: From Settings, Workspace Settings, API. It stays on this machine.

form.label: Publication id (blank if you have one publication)

failures.title: beehiiv did not accept that key
failures.detail: Create a new key under Settings, Workspace Settings, API, and paste it again.

methods.label: Kit
methods.detail: A V4 API key from your Kit account. Drafts and stats work on the free plan.

setup.title: Create a V4 API key in Kit
setup.detail: In Kit open Settings, then Developer, and click Add a new key under V4 API Keys. Name it Dimension and copy the key. A V3 key or secret does not work here.

form.label: Kit V4 API key
form.help: From Settings, Developer, V4 API Keys. It stays on this machine. Run newsletter_provider after connecting to check it.

methods.label: Buttondown
methods.detail: Your Buttondown API key. Buttondown's API is part of its paid plans.

setup.title: Copy your Buttondown API key
setup.detail: In Buttondown open Settings, then API, and copy the key.

form.label: Buttondown API key
form.help: From Settings, API. It stays on this machine.

failures.title: Buttondown did not accept that key
failures.detail: Copy the key again from Settings, API, and paste it.

methods.label: Ghost
methods.detail: An Admin API key from a custom integration on your Ghost site.

setup.title: Add a custom integration in Ghost
setup.detail: In Ghost Admin open Settings, search for Integrations, click Add custom integration and name it Dimension.

setup.title: Copy the Admin API key and the API URL
setup.detail: The integration shows an Admin API key (two parts joined by a colon) and an API URL (your admin address, for example https://yoursite.ghost.io). Copy both.

form.label: API URL
form.help: The API URL the integration shows: your Ghost admin address. It must start with https://, so the Admin API key never travels unencrypted.

form.label: Admin API key
form.help: The integration's Admin API key, id and secret joined by a colon. It stays on this machine. Run newsletter_provider after connecting to check it.

tools.name: newsletter_provider
tools.description: Which email providers are connected and the publication each key reaches, checked live.

tools.name: newsletter_list_issues
tools.description: List drafts and sent issues, newest first, with ids for the stats tool.

tools.name: newsletter_issue_stats
tools.description: One sent issue's numbers: delivered, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes, clicks, replies; opens marked unreliable.

tools.name: newsletter_audience
tools.description: Subscriber counts and growth, never addresses.

tools.name: newsletter_issue_draft
tools.description: Save the chosen issue as an UNSENT draft in the provider. Never sends or schedules.
